description: มุน 2026-08-06 (ฟีม's ruling, แบบ ก): four controls were drawn as buttons and did nothing when tapped — the อัพเกรด pill (AppHeader), the profile avatar (TopBarAvatar), the full-width lime CTA on the day-detail upsell card (the riskiest: it sits under a ฿99/เดือน price line, so a silent tap reads as a broken checkout rather than an unbuilt feature), and the day-detail bottom CTA during loading. The codebase had been solving this the honest-but-silent way — render a <span> so no dead <button> swallows the tap (TopBarAvatar's own header records that earlier ruling). Silence is truthful to the markup and to a screen reader, but on a phone it is indistinguishable from a broken app: the user taps, nothing moves, and they conclude the button is broken. ฟีม superseded it: the control becomes real and ANSWERS 'เร็วๆ นี้' (features/v2-shell/components/ComingSoon.tsx — module-level store so two quick taps cannot stack two notices, role=status + aria-live so the answer reaches a screen reader too, fixed and out of flow so it cannot shift the page). The loading CTA is deliberately NOT a coming-soon case: that action is real and merely a few hundred ms from ready, so it says 'กำลังโหลด…' and is disabled — it refuses the press instead of pretending to accept it. A regression was caught mid-change and is worth recording: the first version keyed the loading state off `!ctaLabel`, which also catches undefined, and /v2/calendar/notifications passes no label in state 'saved' — it would have lost '✓ คุณบันทึกลงปฏิทินแล้ว' and shown a disabled 'กำลังโหลด…'. '' and undefined mean different things; only the explicit empty string is the loading signal. The fifth item on ฟีม's list, DayStrip's arrows at a month edge, was examined and left alone: they are already aria-hidden at 40% opacity, which is a correctly disabled affordance rather than a dead control. gate_layer=behaviour.
